lines.head: KNOWN — American Psychiatric Association, Dec 1973
lines.text: voted homosexuality out of its manual
lines.source: Jack Drescher, “Out of DSM: Depathologizing Homosexuality”, Behavioral Sciences 5(4):565–575, 2015 (PMC4695779): “in December 1973, APA's Board of Trustees (BOT) voted to remove homosexuality from the DSM”; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4695779/ read 15 Nov 2026

lines.head: TAUGHT IN — Love in Action handbook (1995), pp. 130, 132

lines.head: TAUGHT IN — Love in Action handbook (1995), p. 13
lines.source: Love in Action, Helping People Step Out of Homosexuality, revised edition © 1995 (first published © 1984), Smithsonian National Museum of American History, Archives Center, NMAH.AC.1428 (the Mattachine Society of Washington “Love in Action” Collection), Box 2 Folder 13, printed p. 13 (PDF p. 21): “The security of a child depends on a three-way bond: mother to child, father to child and … father to mother”; “Any break in this triangle will produce insecurity in the child … whether the break is real or only perceived by the child, the results are the same.”

lines.head: TAUGHT IN — Exodus booklets #PR-01 to #PR-13 (1993–98)
lines.text: the library is invented; an Exodus booklet cost 1.00 in 1987
lines.source: Exodus International–North America, Resource Booklets (Smithsonian National Museum of American History, Archives Center, NMAH.AC.1428 (the Mattachine Society of Washington “Love in Action” Collection), Box 2 Folder 12): the codes run #PR-01 (© 1996), #PR-02 (© 1993), #PR-06 and #PR-09 (© 1993), #PR-13 (© 1998); the back page “Resource Booklets” (PDF p. 13) lists five booklet categories. The price: the 1987 Exodus edition of Emotional Dependency, back cover, “1.00” (Box 2 Folder 9, PDF p. 15). Both read on the page images, 15 Nov 2026. The “TriedPath Pocket Library” and its phone number are invented.

lines.head: TAUGHT IN — Focus on the Family booklet (2001), p. 39
lines.text: a real video, sold for $20; this listing is from 2001
lines.source: Focus on the Family, the truth comes out: The Roots and Causes of Male Homosexuality (© 2001), resources pages, printed p. 39 (PDF p. 22): “Understanding Homosexuality: Roots and Recovery … This video is for you! It looks at developmental factors … An overview of nine proven principles is provided. (Please note product quality is not typical of Focus on the Family offers. However, we make this resource available due to the relevance of its message.) $20”; Smithsonian National Museum of American History, Archives Center, NMAH.AC.1428 (the Mattachine Society of Washington “Love in Action” Collection), Box 6 Folder 5; read on the page image, 15 Nov 2026. Dated 2001, later than this tape's year; the video's own date is not printed.

lines.head: TAUGHT IN — Love in Action handbook (1995), pp. 128–129
lines.source: Love in Action, Helping People Step Out of Homosexuality, revised edition © 1995 (first published © 1984), Smithsonian National Museum of American History, Archives Center, NMAH.AC.1428 (the Mattachine Society of Washington “Love in Action” Collection), Box 2 Folder 13, Chapter Thirteen, “Displacement: Putting Off/Putting On”, printed p. 128 (PDF p. 136): “Displacement is the idea that one thing pushes out or dislodges another”, “There is no neutral ground”; printed p. 129 (PDF p. 137): “If there is a vacancy there, evil will fill it”, “Interference is the technical name for displacement.”

lines.head: TAUGHT IN — Love in Action handbook (1995), p. 129
lines.source: Love in Action, Helping People Step Out of Homosexuality, revised edition © 1995 (first published © 1984), Smithsonian National Museum of American History, Archives Center, NMAH.AC.1428 (the Mattachine Society of Washington “Love in Action” Collection), Box 2 Folder 13, printed p. 129 (PDF p. 137): “At the end of a thirty-day period, we forget about 80 percent of everything we learned on day one … for the person who has come out of involvement in the gay lifestyle, this principle can be a blessing.” The handbook cites unnamed college “learning surveys”; the figure is shown as the teaching, not as fact.

lines.head: KNOWN — World Health Organization, ICD-10, May 1990
lines.text: orientation by itself is “not to be regarded as a disorder”

lines.head: TAUGHT IN — a church flyer, Thursday 11 June 1992
lines.text: its title, hooks and topics are the flyer's own
lines.source: The flyer “Women Relating to Men … For All Married and Single Women”: “You may be saying.... “I Don't Want To Go To This Class!””, five “Topics to be covered” (among them “Single women relating to ex-gay men”), “Don't end up saying.... “I Wish I Had Gone To This Class””, June 11, 1992, Thursday, 7:30 P.M.; Smithsonian National Museum of American History, Archives Center, NMAH.AC.1428 (the Mattachine Society of Washington “Love in Action” Collection), Box 1 Folder 3 (“Women Only”), PDF p. 17; read on the page image, 15 Nov 2026. The presenters' names and the church are not used; “TriedPath Fellowship · Fellowship Hall” and the phone number are invented.
